title: When an Authorization Gap Begins on an Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Decision table — Insured Plan of Care authorization gaps.** When the gap in authorization coverage begins depends on how the authorization ran out:

| How the authorization ran out | The gap begins |
|---|---|
| The last approval drawn on had all of its visits drawn | The day after the visit that drew its last visit |
| No approval has ever been drawn on | The day after the evaluation |
| Otherwise (the last approval drawn on still had visits left) | The day after the end date of the last approval drawn on |

An approval has had all of its visits drawn when the visits billed against its authorization number are as many as the visits it approved.

## Hypothetical cases

1. An approval for 12 visits covering 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-31; its 12th visit was drawn on 2026-05-19. The gap begins 2026-05-20, not after the approval's end date.
2. An approval for 12 visits covering 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-10; 9 visits drawn, the last on 2026-05-08. The gap begins 2026-05-11, the day after the approval's end date.
3. A plan whose evaluation was billed on 2026-04-20 and on which no visit has ever drawn an authorized visit. The gap begins 2026-04-21.
